Ov Hell | Ov Hell is a Norwegian black metal supergroup started by Shagrath and King ov Hell in 2009.  The band's debut album, "The Underworld Regime", was released in February 2010 by Indie Recordings.

True Norwegian Black Metal – Live in Grieghallen | True Norwegian Black Metal – Live in Grieghallen is Gorgoroth's first full-length live album, released by Regain Records. Infernus dedicated the album to the late Jon Nödtveidt of Dissection.

Former Gorgoroth members Gaahl and King ov Hell adopted the name in March 2009 following the ending of the Gorgoroth name dispute.
